priorIssues.issue: w22b-1 / w22a-1 (medium) head-on light chin band under the cover plate; rolled foot overhanging the plate edge

What remains head-on is a 1 px stitch line at L84-85 on top and a 1 px lip at L97 (1.8x) over a 1 px L64-65 ramp, then the shadow L61; y_47300 has a 1-2 px lip at 1.3-1.5x - the lip is 1 px wide, so it reads as a crease highlight, not a chin. e4 corners (z_corners.png): the foot now stops ~1 px inside both plate edges, no overhang (w22 ~3 px past the right edge). Close up the lift is now the foot alone: e4 band L40-42 over face 37 (1.08x), foot peak L61-64 (1.65x) over ~4 px; mean of the lowest 15 px ~1.27x (target was >= 1.35, y_47306 hem 1.55-1.6x) - slightly under, acceptable as the compromise between head-on and oblique. Far LOD: with the band now at face colour the missing LOD hem no longer pops.
